visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A host in a floral-patterned midi dress stands in a well-lit indoor room featuring a grand piano and full bookshelves. She claps her hands excitedly while looking off-camera. (2) A title card appears with a portrait of a female violinist and a detailed list of her international awards and education in white text on a dark background. (3) A violinist in a black long-sleeve dress enters the frame, holding a violin and bow. She stands next to the host, who is laughing and gesturing towards her. A large stone Buddha statue is visible behind them. (4) A rapid-fire game sequence begins where circular icons of famous classical composers (Beethoven, Paganini, etc.) appear on the screen. The violinist smiles and points to indicate her preferences. (5) The camera switches to a medium shot of the violinist performing. She moves her bow rapidly across the strings with intense focus, wearing a black dress against a backdrop of bookshelves. (6) The video concludes with a promotional overlay showing a large concert hall crowd and upcoming concert dates in June 2025.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A loud, high-pitched female exclamation of 'Welcome!' is accompanied by rhythmic hand clapping and an applause track SFX. The energy is extremely high. (2) An upbeat, moderate-tempo pop-classical hybrid BGM track starts, featuring driving electronic percussion and a bright synth melody. (3) Two female voices engage in a rapid, friendly dialogue in English and Mandarin. The vocal tone is cheerful and bright with frequent rising intonations. (4) A rapid sequence of percussive 'Ding' bell SFX occurs every 2 seconds, marking choices in a game format while a woman laughs and speaks quickly. (5) The pop BGM fades slightly, replaced by a prominent, solo violin track playing a virtuosic, high-frequency classical passage with crisp articulation and fast tempo. (6) The segment ends with a resurgence of cheering SFX, an upbeat orchestral stinger, and the final female voice saying 'Welcome to Taiwan!' with high enthusiasm.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the upcoming 2025 performance of world-renowned violinist Bomsori Kim in Taiwan by humanizing her through a game and showcasing her immense musical skill.
